subject.title: fix(ui): dark theme AA contrast for coral fills, widget accent-fill token

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `--accent-fill` as the public widget primary-action token, sourced from host `--primary` and `--primary-foreground`, for all supported and custom themes?
rationale: This is an additive cross-boundary widget contract change, and the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling even though the patch and visual evidence are otherwise strong.

options.title: Approve the token contract
options.body: Accept `--accent-fill` as the stable primary-action token after confirming existing theme families expose compatible primary and foreground values.

options.title: Keep the existing token vocabulary
options.body: Avoid the new widget token and use an approved existing host/widget semantic token instead, if maintainers do not want to expand the public wrapper contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the token contract
recommendation.body: Accept `--accent-fill` as the stable primary-action token after confirming existing theme families expose compatible primary and foreground values.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged widget design-system contract and are the strongest available history-based routing candidate.
